title: althaea microphylla
intro: Althaea microphylla, commonly known as the small marshmallow, is a perennial herb belonging to the Malvaceae family. The health benefits of Althaea microphylla include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect and calm mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Althaea microphylla include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
